arek_v1_game-match:
Pixel-art fighting-game sprite sheet of the SAME character shown in the reference image, redrawn in 12 poses for a 2.5D beat 'em up in the spirit of Little Fighter 2. Every pose is a strict SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Layout: exactly 4 columns x 3 rows grid of equal cells, one full-body figure centred in each cell, feet on the same baseline near the bottom of each cell, no overlaps, no labels, no numbers, no text, no grid lines. Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour everywhere, no shadows on the ground, no gradients.
Row 1: (1) fighting stance idle, fists up; (2) walking step; (3) running, leaning forward, big stride; (4) jab punch, front arm fully extended forward.
Row 2: (5) second punch with the other arm, extended; (6) high kick forward; (7) jumping in the air, knees tucked; (8) flying jump kick, leg extended forward.
Row 3: (9) blocking/defending, both forearms crossed in front of the face; (10) getting hit, head snapped back, body bent backwards; (11) knocked down lying flat on the back on the ground; (12) throwing a red apple forward overhand, special move.
Keep the character's identity, outfit, colours and pixel-art rendering consistent across all 12 cells.
Character: Arek, young man with curly brown hair, dark blue sunglasses, short-sleeved navy-and-white vertical striped shirt and matching striped shorts, white sneakers with light-blue socks, bare forearms and calves, thick dark outline.
Style: match the reference sprite exactly — same head-to-body proportions (about 4.5 heads tall), same chunky dark 1-2 px outline, same 16-bit shading and palette.
